selection.rule: Rank eligible Peninsula danger rasters by distinct node classes descending, class range descending, mean node class descending, validity ascending, model time ascending, raster SHA ascending. Select top 3 plus the v1.3 reference raster if absent. No policy results enter selection.

protocol.event_locations: uniform eligible nodes; independent of hazard
protocol.fleet_status: Experimental modeled fleet and station locations; not official operational resources

limitations: Forecast validities may share one model issue. No independent historical AEMET archive was obtained. No temporal generalization or operational efficacy.
